description:
🧱 A factory fire almost ended it. Then one tiny brick changed everything 🔥

📼 This retro-style motion piece tells how LEGO went from a small wooden toy business fighting to survive to a global creative empire. In 1932, Danish carpenter Ole Kirk Christiansen started making wooden toys in Billund, Denmark. Two years later he named the company LEGO, from the Danish phrase “leg godt,” meaning “play well” 🇩🇰

🏭 Then came a devastating factory fire, financial challenges, and a bold turn toward plastic toys. In 1958, LEGO patented its iconic interlocking brick design, the foundation of a system that would turn it into a worldwide phenomenon 🚀

🎞️ Built with that vintage throwback look: archival-inspired imagery, animated typography, vintage textures, and satisfying brick-based transitions carrying the story from humble beginnings to global success

💡 The story isn’t just about a famous brand. It’s about the decisions, setbacks, and innovations that made that success possible
